blocks.text: This article provides a summary of all new features and enhancements released per operating system (OS) for the Zscaler Digital Experience (ZDX) Module in the Zscaler Client Connector app.

blocks.heading: Release Available: ZDX Module 4.0 for Windows

blocks.item: Gives visibility of the underlay hops through reverse traceroute from Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge in environments where the firewall blocks Internet Control Message Protocol (ICMP) responses from upstream routers.
Provides the error reason for REST API failures.
Changes the port of Cloud Path probes, using the UDP protocol, to the translation port in the DNAT environment.
Improves event aggregation information from Zscaler Client Connector to ZDX.
Improves database operations by increasing Structured Query Language (SQL) parameters.

Supports running ZDX as a 64-bit application. During upgrades, 32-bit versions will continue to upgrade to 32-bit versions. If you are interested in the 64-bit version, contact the Zscaler Account team to enable it for your organization.
Substitutes the Periphery router IP with the Egress IP, which is obtained from the Zscaler Service API when Public IP addresses are used on the network.
Updates device inventory’s identification of Zscaler services in addition to the installed programs in the Windows registry.
Fixes an issue where the logic for the packet capture’s received and sent timestamps was incorrect.
Fixes an issue where the traceroute failed because the Destination Network Address Translation (DNAT) router was listening on a different port instead of the probe port.
Fixes an issue where the external proxy GRE was not detected in the location API endpoint.
Fixes an issue where the incorrect latency number was displayed on the gateway to egress when there was an increasing amount of packet failures.

blocks.heading: Release Available: ZDX Module 3.9.0.55 for Windows

blocks.text: Fixes an issue where the ZDX Adaptive probe uses ICMP protocol and targets the incorrect IP address in Tunnel 2.0 mode when the PAC file has the DNS name as the proxy.

blocks.heading: Release Available: ZDX Module 3.9.0.52 for Windows

blocks.text: Fixes an issue where the bandwidth test failed due to a low API request timeout.

blocks.heading: Release Available: ZDX Module 3.9 for Windows

blocks.item: Admins can allow non-admins access to the Zscaler Client Connector logs folder.
Supports location groups as a criteria when configuring a new probe or an alert rule.

Supports Self Service to improve end user experience by diagnosing and providing recommendations to resolve issues due to high CPU usage and poor Wi-Fi connection to reduce the amount of calls to the IT help desk.
Fixes an issue where the Egress IP address is shown as the App Connector IP address for private apps.
Fixes an issue where the ZDX Score drops when a third-party proxy is applied via PAC.
Fixes an issue with error reporting when Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) is unable to connect to an application.

blocks.heading: Release Available: ZDX Module 3.8 for Windows

blocks.item: Provides support for ZDX Autosense probes by dynamically detecting and probing the endpoints.
Supports bandwidth testing for ZDX Deep Tracing sessions to provide an in-depth analysis of network health.
Supports external proxy bypasses in ZDX.
Supports Destination Network Address Translation (DNAT) in the ZDX Cloud Path.
Supports ZDX Cloud Path probes through an external proxy on the system.
Supports ZDX Web and Cloud Path probes via external proxy when they are added in the Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) app segments.
Fixes an issue where the ZPA Web probes fail when there is an external proxy applied to the system.
Fixes an issue where an incorrect label was reported for ZPA Cloud Path in case of a probe failure.
Fixes the error code for Deep Tracing sessions where the connector legs mapping was incorrect.

blocks.heading: Release Available: ZDX Module 3.3.1.53 for Windows

blocks.text: Improves the accuracy of computing ZDX probe stats.

blocks.heading: Release Available: ZDX Module 3.7.1.31 for Windows

blocks.item: Supports Webex Call Quality Management (CQM) for Zscaler Client Connector and ZDX.
Fixes an issue where multiple notifications were sent frequently due to a crash in the ZDX module.
Fixes an issue where the ZDX Admin Portal was missing the PCAP File Path during a deep tracing session.

blocks.heading: Release Available: ZDX Module 3.7.0.14 for Windows

blocks.item: Extends the interoperability between Zscaler Client Connector and ZDX versions to a broader range.
Removes legacy ciphers from the Zscaler Client Connector’s TLS and SSL connections for compliance.

blocks.heading: Release Available: ZDX Module 3.6.0.68 for Windows

blocks.item: Improves the tunnel detection logic using web probe caching when HTTP probes are disabled on the network.
Improves connection management between Zscaler Client Connector and TPG.
Provides error information where Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) Public Service Edge or ZIA Private Service Edge detection failed when the system resolved to DNS v6 only.
Reduces CPU consumption by optimizing database I/O operations.
Fixes an issue where ZDX ignored the port’s unreachable response for UDP packets.
Fixes an issue when Zscaler Client Connector picked up the protocol for ZIA to the server from the ZIA egress section of the MTR response, which resulted in incorrect reporting.
Fixes an issue where the nonresponsive hop on the egress leg was shown in the ZIA Public Service Edge or ZIA Private Service Edge leg in the tunnel case.
Fixes an issue where the ZDX cloud path failed in a no default route (NDR) environment.
Fixes the differential latency logic when there were unresponsive hops in a tunnel case.

blocks.heading: Release Available: ZDX Module 3.5.0.59 for Windows

blocks.item: Improves egress detection more accurately and uses it as a destination for the reverse cloud path from Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge.
Fixes a TCP traceroute cloud path error by using the hops data from adaptive trace route.

blocks.heading: Release Available: ZDX Module 3.3.1.52 for Windows

blocks.item: Improves egress detection more accurately and uses it as a destination for the reverse cloud path from Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) Public Service Edge or ZIA Private Service Edge.
Fixes an issue where the hops appear incorrectly in the Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) Public Service Edge or ZIA Private Service Edge leg instead of the egress leg.
